terms.summary: Give up on a Mission: clear it from your sheet and face the consequences.
The single d6 you roll in an action roll.
1d6 + attribute vs 2d10; Stylish, Flat, Failure.
Action die plus modifiers; compared against each challenge die.
In multiplayer games, a character controlled by another player.
Power that restores the appearance of a living body to your corpse.
Using random tables to generate answers, surprises or inspiration.
Character trait: capability, relationship, or resource; six types.
The four core stats: Body, Mind, Charm, Soul; main modifier for action rolls.
Value Rush resets to when cooled; starts at +2.
Face Danger, Secure an Advantage, Compel, Gather Information, Hunt.
Abnormal vampiric weakness from the Blighted condition.
The Burden related to Conscience; you develop a Blight.
Animating force; slumber, feeding, appear alive.
A Connection transformed by sharing vampiric blood, by you or by them.
Attribute: physical strength, resistance, agility and coordination.
The Burden related to Standing; permanently marked by vampire authorities.
Aspect type: permanent condition; first ability negative, extra abilities exploit it.
First Standing condition: warned by authorities to step in line.
The two d10s rolled against your action die.
Attribute: persuasiveness, charisma, composure.
Mental balance; respite; cascade In Shock to Traumatized.
Attack rolls, damage per rank, winning and losing.
Basic action to persuade, negotiate or ask a favor.
Enduring consequence when a meter at 0 loses more, or a Tenet test fails.
Ranked relationship; Pulse, Sealed, Bloodied, testing.
Tenet: trying rolls; cascade Detached to Blighted.
Replace your action score with current Rush, then reset to base Rush.
First Conscience condition: momentarily separated from your humanity.
Second Standing condition: standing collapses until you serve your authority.
Aspect type: non-skill resource or asset, such as wealth or fame.
The perpetual pursuit of new meaning that fills the void left by death.
Second Blood condition: instinct overwhelms you; only violence until control returns.
Gain on failure; spend 10 to upgrade, 15 to acquire.
Aspect type: trained skill such as driving, lying or brawling.
Basic action to attempt something risky or react to an imminent threat.
Political group in the vampire world; fiction only, no mechanical stats.
Worst result: your action score beats neither challenge die.
Action roll to drink from a prey, rolling with Soul; restores Blood.
Middle result: your action score beats exactly one challenge die.
Action roll to channel blood for a supernatural power; costs Blood.
In multiplayer, the player who guides conversation, world and adversaries.
Basic action to seek or analyze information or evidence.
One-size-fits-all mechanic when no basic action fits.
Aspect type: vampiric powers; up to three innate, more learned from others.
Body integrity; regenerate with Body; cascade Wounded to Scarred.
Basic action to quickly look for fresh blood and feed.
First Clarity condition: deeply distressed; you must rest.
Lingering question; +1 XP when tied.
Second Health condition: lose a body part; it regrows over several nights.
Doubles on challenge dice: Twist, Misfortune, Impulse.
Attribute: intelligence, sharpness, resolve.
Ranked progress track; fulfilling roll, recommit, abandon.
Aspect type: a family of magical powers; never innate, always learned from another.
Any character not controlled by a player.
Random tables generating answers, surprises or inspiration.
d100 consequence table for Flat and Failure results.
Second Conscience condition: guilt drives a redemption Mission.
The vampire who turned you.
Ten-box track measuring headway; fill speed depends on Rank.
Connection or NPC durability, max Rank + 2.
1-to-5 rating: Mission complexity, NPC power, or combat durability.
Restore Health: roll with Body.
One of four meters (Health, Clarity, Blood, Rush) that deplete under stress.
Restore Clarity in a safe place.
Add the chosen Attribute's value to your action die as main modifier.
Bonus pool; cool it to replace a low action score.
The Burden related to Health: a wound that leaves a permanent scar.
Connection whose track is completely filled: honest mutual trust.
Basic action to assess, prepare or gain leverage.
End of night: lose 1 Blood, gain +1 Rush, write a Loose End.
Attribute: empathy, honesty, self-control, humaneness.
Tenet: trying rolls; cascade Cautioned to Branded.
First Blood condition: hunger sharpens into desperation.
Best result: your action score beats both challenge dice.
Trait tried with an action roll when challenged; failure causes Conditions.
Second Clarity condition: dreaded vision; commit to a Rank 4 Mission.
The Burden related to Blood: animating power permanently weakened.
The Burden related to Clarity: psyche permanently damaged.
World assumptions: origins, powers, population, politics, territory.
End-of-scene roll with Soul after taking a life or bloodying a Connection.
End-of-night roll with Charm after violating vampire laws or customs.
Drain a mortal to death, then feed the corpse a drop of vampiric blood.
First Health condition: your corpse struggles to hold together; regenerate.
See Experience.
